review.notes: Full review. All six findings of the previous review are repaired. Adversarial table of 24 rows with computed values, including all twelve Lean theorems (brute-force recomputation of the four classical lists; Matveev and Yu statements derived from the supplier's). Gate passes (worker, every counter 0, build 0); lake env lean gives twelve sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes none; depcheck 0 problems. Five P3 findings: scaffold-describing API/Check bullets, duplicated Checks, damaged code spans and sentences, suppliers missing from the contracts and layer Dependencies, one wrong internal reference and one Check outside its theorem's hypothesis. Not verified: de Weger Lemma 3.15 sign and the TdW 1992 section 15 table (dropped by the extraction), published page numbers of Bruin-Stoll, matveev2000 and yu1994 texts, numerical tables of sections 6.19-6.31 and 6.35.
